title: Surface network worker per-layer status and failure reasons
summary: Implement A3 from the network worker hardening plan by propagating structured worker failure reasons and exposing distinct network diagnostic layer indicators.
reason: Operators need network failures to distinguish URL reachability, auth, path access, queue freshness, claim status, and pipeline failure causes instead of seeing an ambiguous issue count or generic failed status.
behavior_before: Network evidence and failed worker reports could collapse distinct timeout, auth, source-path, output-path, and encode failures into generic failed/issue labels.
behavior_after: Coordinator and WebView evidence will report distinct diagnostic layer statuses and failed jobs will retain bounded reason_code and reason details.
